purpose: Findings listed here are intentionally visible in SEC-2 evidence and are not supply-chain allowlist suppressions.

findings.remove_when: Remove when the pinned aws-cdk-lib bundles minimatch >= 11.0.1 (the patched version for GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249).
findings.justification: minimatch 10.2.6 is bundled inside aws-cdk-lib 2.275.0 in examples/cdk-multilang (inBundle: true). The pin was re-reviewed on 2026-11-01: aws-cdk-lib 2.275.0, still the latest release, declares and bundles minimatch ^10.2.6, so no aws-cdk-lib release fixes this, and npm overrides cannot replace a dependency shipped inside the aws-cdk-lib tarball (verified: an override leaves the bundled lock entry at 10.2.6). Operator ruling 2026-10-03: "if a vulnerable dependency is bundled in AWS we make an exception until its updated there"; extended 2026-10-04 to AWS-published build-toolchain chains. Scoped to exactly GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 at the bundled node path; scripts/test-npm-audit-policy.sh pins the bundled version and fails when it moves.

findings.remove_when: Remove together with the bundled minimatch GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 entry when the pinned aws-cdk-lib bundles minimatch >= 11.0.1.
findings.justification: Derived parent entry: npm audit reports aws-cdk-lib itself as vulnerable solely because it bundles the vulnerable minimatch covered by the sibling GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 entry (via: ["minimatch"]). Same operator ruling 2026-10-03 (AWS-bundled vulnerable dependency, exception until AWS updates it; 2026-10-04 extension to AWS-published build-toolchain chains). Scoped to exactly package aws-cdk-lib at node_modules/aws-cdk-lib; the bundled leaf entry must exist for this entry to remain valid (scripts/test-npm-audit-policy.sh enforces the pair).
